name: chaintrace
description: Blockchain Powered Social Media Identity Verification & Fake Profile Detection

scripts.dev:with-ai: concurrently "npm run ai:service" "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.ai:service: cd ai_engine && npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.build: npm run build:ai && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
